# Airbnb UAE

> > Airbnb's UAE platform connecting travelers with local experiences, activities, and tours across global destinations including the Baltic Sea region, Boston, and Arabian Sea areas.

Airbnb.ae serves as the United Arab Emirates portal for Airbnb's global marketplace of experiences, tours, and activities. The platform features curated local experiences ranging from historical walking tours in Boston's Freedom Trail to cultural activities in the Arabian Sea region and sightseeing adventures across Baltic Sea destinations like Tallinn, Vilnius, and Stockholm.

## Key Topics

- Airbnb Experiences
- Baltic Sea destinations (Tallinn, Vilnius, Stockholm)
- Sightseeing tours and activities
- Boston historical tours (Freedom Trail, Beacon Hill)
- Arabian Sea cultural experiences
- Local guided walks and activities
- Art and culture experiences
- Food and drink tours
- Nature and outdoor activities
- Stockholm archipelago and Gamla Stan
- Historical tours and heritage sites
- Regional tourism (Massachusetts, Dubai, Abu Dhabi)
- Local experience booking
- Cultural immersion activities

## Regional Experiences & Activities

- [Things to do in Baltic Sea | Experiences, Activities, Tours & More! - Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.ae/baltic-sea/things-to-do): Baltic Sea experiences: tours, activities & local sightseeing
- [Art and Culture Activities in Arabian Sea | Experiences, Activities & More! - Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.ae/arabian-sea/things-to-do/art-and-culture): Arabian Sea art & culture experiences in Dubai & Abu Dhabi region
- [Sightseeing in Boston | Experiences, Activities & More! - Massachusetts - Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.ae/boston-ma/things-to-do/sightseeing): Boston sightseeing activities including Freedom Trail & Beacon Hill tours
